title: Among magnet schools in counties with at least one school offering exclusiv
question: Among magnet schools in counties with at least one school offering exclusively virtual instruction (Virtual = 'F'), find the top 3 cities with the lowest total K-12 enrollment. For each of these cities, return the city name, the number of such magnet schools, and the average eligible free meal rate (Free Meal Count (K-12) / Enrollment (K-12)) across those schools.

prediction.sql:
WITH virtual_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT XCL_045 AS county
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_076 = 'F'
),
magnet_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_050 AS city,
        f.XCL_020 AS free_meal_count,
        f.XCL_019 AS enrollment
    FROM schools s
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN virtual_counties vc ON s.XCL_045 = vc.county
    WHERE s.XCL_077 = 1
)
SELECT
    city,
    COUNT(*) AS magnet_school_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN enrollment > 0 THEN CAST(free_meal_count AS REAL) / enrollment ELSE 0 END) AS avg_free_meal_rate
FROM magnet_schools
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY SUM(enrollment) ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH virtual_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT XCL_045 AS county
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_076 = 'F'
),
magnet_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_050 AS city,
        f.XCL_020 AS free_meal_count,
        f.XCL_019 AS enrollment
    FROM schools s
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN virtual_counties vc ON s.XCL_045 = vc.county
    WHERE s.XCL_077 = 1
)
SELECT
    city,
    COUNT(*) AS magnet_school_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN enrollment > 0 THEN CAST(free_meal_count AS REAL) / enrollment ELSE 0 END) AS avg_free_meal_rate
FROM magnet_schools
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY SUM(enrollment) ASC
LIMIT 3
